characters.name: Tove
characters.want: wants everyone back in their own house before the thaw
characters.greeting: We sleep together so we dream together. Don't touch anything.
characters.claims: I dreamed that. Of course I did. Sit down and eat something.
characters.not_mine: That's not mine. Whose is it? Put it in front of them, not me.

request.text: Jorun doesn't sleep. The stove shed has the herbs; make her something.

lines.text: The herbs are on the shelf in the stove shed. Stand at the stove and hold still; it takes a while to come right.
You made them. Good. Don't tell me what's in them, and don't tell Jorun either.
One more window lit. One fewer bunk to bank the stove for. Jorun snores, you know. Did you know?
Bo is up a ladder with a window of his own. That is two. Nine to go, and the thaw does not wait.
You put a dream in front of the wrong face this morning. It happens. The face remembers, though.

characters.name: Jorun
characters.want: wants to get down to the lake without the ladder
characters.greeting: You're going to sleep to help me. Bold. I've been doing that for years and the ice never once fixed itself.
characters.claims: I dreamed that. Don't look so pleased with yourself.
characters.not_mine: That's not mine. I'd know. Nothing of mine has ever been that cheerful.

lines.text: Sixteen steps. I counted them twice. I live at the top now, and the fish live at the bottom, and nobody needs the ladder. Don't touch the railing.
Tove says you made me something. It's bitter. I slept until the stove went out. Keep the rest in the Long House, by the bunk, where I won't find them.
Fourth time. I am not a stair. I am not a ladder either. Go to sleep and stay there.
Three times now. Tove has started a column for it. I told her to use a bigger wall.
Twice. You woke up shouting twice. The stove heard you. The stove hears everything.
You woke up shouting. Once. Everyone does once. Do it again and I start counting.
You woke up screaming and chose a spoon. Out of everything. I've told the fish.
You offered somebody else's dream to the wrong face this morning. I saw. The face is still sulking.

characters.name: Bo
characters.want: wants a place above the ground to sew
characters.greeting: Bo. Hats, mostly. Don't ask about the needle, I'm not ready to talk about the needle.
characters.claims: I dreamed that. Give it here, I know exactly what it's for.
characters.not_mine: That's not mine. I'd have knitted a cosy for it by now if it were.

lines.text: A loft. Up a ladder, above the snow, with a window. I'm sewing something ridiculous first and something useful after, if there's wool.
That hat is taller than the old one. Things will stay under it. Don't thank me, I needed the practice.
You offered me somebody else's dream. At breakfast. In front of everyone. I'm still thinking about it.
Jorun told me about the spoon. I think a spoon is fine. A spoon is a small thing that works.
